fullPassage: Patterns such as infinite scroll, autoplaying videos, or requiring an account just to make a purchase all interfere with the user's control over their own experience. From a sustainability perspective, many of these patterns encourage overconsumption of data and attention. Infinite scroll keeps loading new content whether the user wants it or not, increasing data usage and device processing. Autoplay forces media to load and play even for people who may never watch it. These choices consume more energy on both the user's device and the servers delivering the content. Take the decision by a popular music streaming platform to replace static album artwork with short video loops by default. This change significantly increases data usage and battery consumption, while the option to disable it is buried deep in the settings. As a result, most users consume more resources unless they actively search for a way to opt out. It is important to acknowledge that web design always nudges behavior in some way. Showing consequences and highlighting options are all forms of influence. The ethical line is not whether nudging exists, but whether it is transparent, reversible, and aligned with the user's interests. In many cases, the most responsible approach is to make the lower-impact option the default, while keeping alternatives clearly available. Defaults are powerful, and when chosen carefully, they can reduce environmental impact without removing user agency.

웹 디자인은 사용자의 행동에 전혀 영향을 주지 않는다.
무한 스크롤은 사용자의 의사와 무관하게 계속 새로운 콘텐츠를 불러온다.

questions.passage: Patterns such as infinite scroll, autoplaying videos, or requiring an account just to make a purchase all interfere with the user's control over their own experience. From a sustainability perspective, many of these patterns encourage overconsumption of data and attention. Infinite scroll keeps loading new content whether the user wants it or not, increasing data usage and device processing. Autoplay forces media to load and play even for people who may never watch it. These choices consume more energy on both the user's device and the servers delivering the content. Take the decision by a popular music streaming platform to replace static album artwork with short video loops by default. This change significantly increases data usage and battery consumption, while the option to disable it is buried deep in the settings. As a result, most users consume more resources unless they actively search for a way to opt out. It is important to acknowledge that web design always nudges behavior in some way. Showing consequences and highlighting options are all forms of influence. The ethical line is not whether nudging exists, but whether it is transparent, reversible, and aligned with the user's interests. In many cases, the most responsible approach is to make the lower-impact option the default, while keeping alternatives clearly available. Defaults are powerful, and when chosen carefully, they can reduce environmental impact without removing user agency.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 윤리적 경계선은 넛지의 '존재 여부'가 아니라 투명성·되돌릴 수 있음·사용자 이익 부합 여부에 달려 있음 → 불일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'encourage overconsumption of data and attention'과 일치
❌ ② 'replace static album artwork with short video loops'와 일치
✅ ③ 원문은 'The ethical line is not whether nudging exists, but whether it is transparent ...' — 존재 여부 '자체'가 아니라고 함 → 불일치 ←정답
❌ ④ 'reduce environmental impact without removing user agency'와 일치
det.tip: not whether nudging exists, but whether it is transparent = 존재 여부가 아니라 투명성 여부

ch: 지속가능성 관점에서 많은 패턴은 데이터와 주의력의 과소비를 조장한다.
한 음악 스트리밍 플랫폼은 정적 앨범 아트워크를 짧은 영상 루프로 대체하기로 했다.
